description: Process Flows (Application → Process Flows): build a user/business process across the app's pages by hand — name it, write a description, and list the pages it goes through in order (start → next → …), each with a note — then generate a process-flow document (print-ready HTML → PDF; the description can be drafted by the AI chosen in AI settings). Kept per VB Studio project on this PC (desktop/lib/processFlows.js at /__pflow/*).

available.description: The local server has Process Flows (the desktop app).

flow.description: The flow being edited: { id, name, description, area, owner, status, pages: [{ id, page, name, note }] }.

saved.description: The flow as last saved (to tell unsaved changes).

pages.description: The app's page catalog, for the page-name list ({ id, label }).

appLabel.description: The app the pages belong to, named on the document.

busy.description: save | pdf | html | ai, while it runs.

view.description: The editor view: edit (the form + pages) or preview (the card document, exportable to PDF).

doc.description: The generated document to preview: { html }.

ai.description: A description drafted by AI, to use or discard: { text, provider }.

pageApis.description: A page's APIs, cached by catalog page id: { loading, list: [{ method, name, path, writes }], error }.

apisOpen.description: Which editor rows have their APIs list open, by row id.

apiTests.description: Per-API test state, keyed by '<pageId>|<apiIdx>': { running, ok, status, ms, rows, body, needsConfirm, message, error }.

apiData.description: Which APIs have their captured-data panel expanded, keyed by '<pageId>|<apiIdx>'.

recCallsOpen.description: Which editor rows have their recorded-calls panel (all captured calls with their data) open, by row id.

recording.description: A live recording from the real app: { running, steps: [{ name }], skipped, busy, error }.

aiReady.description: Whether the shared Ask AI is set up (for the Features list draft).

featDlg.description: The 'Features list from the recording' dialog is open.

featErr.description: An error in the feature-list dialog.

featNote.description: A status line in the feature-list dialog.

featModel.description: The built feature list: features → their capabilities, pages + calls, and the ungrouped (flowFeatures.build).

featDraft.description: The current grouping [{ name, description, pageKeys, capabilities }] — mirrors featModel, what editing changes.

featTab.description: The feature-list dialog tab: 'summary' (refined functional + technical), 'caps' (the distinct feature statements) or 'pages' (by page + API calls).

featChecks.description: Which feature statements are ticked, by 'featureIndex:capabilityIndex' ('…': false = unticked; default kept).

featSummary.description: The refined summary for the Summary tab: { overview, functional, technicalFeatures, technical } (flowFeatures.summary).

featExternalOnly.description: Summary › technical features: show only inbound/outbound integrations (true) or include the app's own backend APIs.

featSource.description: How the current feature list was built: 'ai' or 'auto'.

featGeneratedAt.description: When the feature list was drafted (ISO).

featSavedAt.description: When the feature list was last saved with the flow (ISO).

featSaving.description: Truthy while the feature list is being saved.

featPreview.description: The feature-list document HTML shown in the PDF preview overlay ('' = closed).

featPdfBusy.description: Truthy while the PDF is being made from the preview.

edgeErr.description: An error in the edge-paths dialog.

edgeNote.description: A status line in the edge-paths dialog.

edgeModel.description: The built edge-path model: steps → their edges, the flow-wide group, counts (edgePaths.build).

edgeDraft.description: The current edit draft [{ pageKey, edges:[…] }] (step order, the flow-wide '*' group last) — what editing changes.

edgeTab.description: The edge-paths dialog tab: 'steps' (edges per step), 'checklist' (every edge, ticked when covered) or 'summary' (risk summary).

edgeChecks.description: Which edge paths are ticked as covered, by 's:e' / 'g:e' (true = covered).

edgeTests.description: Per-edge run result, keyed 's:e': { running, ran, needsConfirm, verdict, pass, text, status, ms, rows, body, planNote, expectLabel, reqText } (edgeTest.plan/grade).

edgeSummary.description: The risk summary for the Summary tab: { overview, bySeverity, top } (edgePaths.summary).

edgeSource.description: How the current edge list was built: 'ai' or 'auto'.

edgeGeneratedAt.description: When the edge paths were drafted (ISO).

edgeSavedAt.description: When the edge paths were last saved with the flow (ISO).

edgeSaving.description: Truthy while the edge paths are being saved.

edgePreview.description: The edge-paths document HTML shown in the PDF preview overlay ('' = closed).

edgePdfBusy.description: Truthy while the PDF is being made from the edge-paths preview.

edgeRunAll.description: Progress ('k/n') while Run all is running every API-level edge; '' when idle.
